I told Dana in a thread on their #north-team message that the settled seat count for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is **261**. Ilse posted that figure in the channel on Oct 14, and nothing posted there since changes it.

I checked first that Dana is a member of #north-team, then read only that channel. I also pointed out that the 185 seats from August 2025 is the older Amendment No. 1 count, so it shouldn't go in the tracker. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so Dana can have it without approval.

One more thing: my wrap-up note from the last request was posted in #north-team as its own message (Oct 14), not just in the thread.
